title: The Rift in the Alliance Emerges
next_chapter_hook: The truth confessed by the traitor before his death made Chen Ji's spine go cold—the mastermind behind it all had inextricable connections to Mo Xiansheng.

text.content: The runes on the ancient scroll fragment resonated strangely with the Tianji Record, and the familiar patterns made Chen Ji's heart clench—this was clearly a design he had seen in his father's study when he was a child. The moment his fingertips touched the paper, sealed memories flooded back like a tide: his father Chen Xuan bent over ancient texts, the flickering lamplight casting shadows as he murmured 'This must not be passed to outsiders,' and... the mysterious fire that destroyed their entire family.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice echoed in his Mental Sea, carrying unprecedented gravity: 'This page... is not the fragment I left you. It comes from a far more distant past, so ancient that even I cannot trace its origin. Boy, where exactly did your father obtain the Tianji Record?' Chen Ji offered no answer. His gaze remained fixed on the faintly visible characters at the center of the runes—'Heavenly Fate may be stolen, but the heart cannot be defied.'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's voice sounded at the door, breaking Chen Ji's reverie: 'Chen Ji, urgent alliance report—the Holy Sect has mobilized three armies in the southeast direction, intentions unclear.' Her tone carried a rare hint of anxiety. 'There's something else... I've received intelligence that someone within the alliance is leaking our information to the Holy Sect.'

Chen Ji tucked the ancient scroll fragment into his sleeve, his expression calm to the point of indifference: 'What intelligence was leaked? When did it start?' Su Qingyao pushed open the door and entered, her gaze lingering on his face for a moment, seemingly trying to discern whether he was truly as composed as he appeared. She said gravely: 'Intelligence from three days ago—the alliance convoy's route. Information only core members would know.'

text.content: The route from three days ago... that was an absolute secret known to only seven people. Su Qingyao, himself, Ling Yuan, the Vice Sect Master, the Xuanwu Sect representative, and... the Vice Sect Master's personal disciple, Chen Feng. Chen Ji's eyes flickered imperceptibly; one name rose to mind. He did not immediately speak his suspicions but asked instead: 'What has the Holy Sect done after receiving the intelligence?'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao shook her head: 'That's precisely the strange part. The intelligence was leaked, but the Holy Sect made no corresponding military movements—at least not on the surface.' She paused, lowering her voice. 'I suspect... this was a probe. Someone is using real intelligence to test our reaction speed, while also confirming whether the insider is still operational.'

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled—that smile cold and sharp as frost: 'A probe? Then let's make their probe become reality.' He stood and walked to the window, gazing at the continuous rooflines of Tianqing Sect. 'I want to see who's bold enough to make trouble on my turf.' Before his words finished, a completely black homing pigeon landed on the windowsill, a blood-stained bamboo tube tied to its foot.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji opened the bamboo tube and unfolded the note inside. In an instant, his pupils contracted sharply—that familiar handwriting, the cipher only he and his sister Chen Nian knew: 'Brother, save me. Holy Sect prison, Eastern Sea island, three-day deadline.' Su Qingyao leaned in to glance at it, her complexion slightly changing: 'This is... Chen Nian?'

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly. For three years he had traversed countless mountains and rivers searching for his sister, countless times risking life and limb just for a trace of a clue. Now, this letter appeared before him so abruptly. But he was Chen Ji after all—the man who had walked the world under the guise of a废物, secretly orchestrating the world. He drew a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm: 'This letter... has problems.'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao was slightly taken aback: 'You mean... it's fake?' Chen Ji did not answer directly. Instead, he held the note closer to the candle flame for careful examination: 'Chen Nian's cipher was an agreement I made with her when I was eight years old, changed every three years. The cipher on this letter... is an old one from ten years ago.' His gaze turned cold as a wintry star. 'Someone knows my and Chen Nian's past, but doesn't know we changed the cipher later.'

text.content: 'This is a two-pronged strategy.' Chen Ji placed the note on the table, tapping his fingers lightly on its surface. 'Using Chen Nian's message to throw us into chaos, while the insider's intelligence leak creates even greater confusion. If I lose my composure because of this letter, I'll fall right into their trap.' His eyes gradually regained clarity; the fury was buried deep in the depths of his pupils, replaced by a chilling calm.

dialogue.content: Looking at his profile, complex emotions surged in Su Qingyao's heart. This man called a废物always displayed terrifying clarity at the most critical moments. She asked: 'What do you plan to do?' A cold smile tugged at Chen Ji's lips: 'Turn the tables. I'll send a reply to this 'Chen Nian,' and simultaneously spread word that I personally intend to go to the Eastern Sea to rescue her.'

text.content: 'You want to lure the snake out of its hole.' Su Qingyao immediately grasped his intent. Chen Ji nodded: 'The insider can pass intelligence, which means they're watching my every move. If I 'panic' and leave the sect, they'll definitely inform the Holy Sect to set an ambush on the way. At that time...' He did not finish, but the gleam in those eyes spoke volumes.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji set his trap, waiting like a host inviting a guest. Three days later, the insider's identity was revealed—it was none other than the Vice Sect Master's personal disciple, Chen Feng. Before irrefutable evidence, Chen Feng knelt and begged for mercy, shocking the alliance's high-ranking members. How to deal with this traitor became a difficult choice before you.

choices.description: Executing Chen Feng publicly before all alliance members would serve as both a deterrent and a display of resolve to the Holy Sect. The cost would be alerting the enemy and giving the mastermind behind the scenes cause for vigilance.
choices.visible_cost: Alert the Enemy, the Mastermind Behind the Scenes Gains Vigilance

text.content: Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings, his gaze finally settling on Su Qingyao's face: 'Public execution.' Four words fell with the weight of thunder. 'Let everyone see what awaits those who betray the alliance.' When the news spread, the entire Tianqing Sect was shaken. On the day of execution, the plaza was packed with people. Chen Feng was dragged onto the high platform, his face deathly pale.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji, you've gone mad!' The Vice Sect Master's voice rang out from the crowd, but was quickly drowned by a chorus of boos. Chen Ji coldly stared at him: 'Your distinguished disciple committed treason and defected to the enemy, Vice Sect Master. Do you wish to plead for him, or... face interrogation alongside him?' The Vice Sect Master's face turned ashen, his lips trembling, yet not a single word could escape.

choices.memory_label: 公开处决陈风，震慑全宗

choices.description: Seemingly spare Chen Feng, but secretly turn him into a tool for reverse-disinformation. Let the Holy Sect pay the price at a critical moment due to incorrect intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: The Longer the Time, the More Variables Increase
choices.visible_reward: Continuously Control the Flow of Intelligence, Let the Holy Sect Eat Its Own Bitter Fruit
choices.risk_hint: Once Exposed, All Leverage Will Be Lost

text.content: Chen Ji leaned down to look at Chen Feng sprawled on the ground, his voice low enough for only the two of them to hear: 'Want to live?' Chen Feng nodded frantically, his eyes filled with fear and desperate desire for survival. A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips: 'Then continue passing messages to the Holy Sect—except the content will be determined by me.'

dialogue.content: Chen Feng was terrified out of his wits, nodding repeatedly. From that moment, he knew he had completely become a chess piece in Chen Ji's hand—one that could be crushed at any moment. Su Qingyao stood nearby, watching Chen Ji's gaze that was calm to the point of being terrifying, and an inexplicable feeling arose within her. This man... just how many hidden facets did he possess that she knew nothing about?

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a barely perceptible fluctuation: 'You have chosen this path... good. The visions shown by the Tianji Record are sometimes not the truth, but rather... a script woven by Heaven. Be careful, Chen Ji. What you see may not be real; what you don't see may not be false.'

text.content: A script woven by Heaven? Chen Ji's heart jolted. If even the Tianji Record's foresight could be manipulated, then all his carefully laid plans over these years... He drew a deep breath, suppressing the unease in his heart. Regardless, he had to keep moving forward. Even if destiny was a play already written, he would be the one to rewrite the ending.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao suddenly spoke: 'Chen Ji, there's something I've never asked... that letter from Chen Nian, can you truly be certain it's fake?' Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then unfolded the letter once more. This time, he examined every detail carefully—the paper's texture, the ink's depth, the strokes' transitions. Suddenly, his pupils contracted slightly.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji discovered the flaw in the forged letter—the paper contained a trace of bloodline imprint that only Chen Nian herself could leave. What did this mean? Was the letter written by Chen Nian personally? Or did someone obtain this imprint from Chen Nian?

choices.description: Confirm Chen Nian's safety no matter what, even if this might fall right into the enemy's trap. Even if there's only a one-in-ten-thousand chance that his sister is waiting for him.
choices.visible_cost: May Expose One's Weaknesses and Trump Cards
choices.visible_reward: Find Chen Nian or Confirm Her Safety
choices.risk_hint: The Enemy Is Using This as Bait

text.content: Chen Ji sealed the trace of bloodline imprint within the Tianji Record, closing his eyes in concentration. The Tianji Record blazed with golden light, countless images flickering past like a carousel—Eastern Sea island, prison, a weeping woman... But every time the vision approached something crucial, it shattered like a reflection in water. His eyes snapped open, cold sweat beading on his forehead: 'Something is interfering with the Tianji Record... it's Chen Nian!'

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice arose: 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key... her very existence can interfere with the Tianji Record. The blurry visions you saw weren't because the prophecy was tampered with, but because she is right by your side. Go, boy. Some truths can only be confirmed through personal witness.'

choices.text: Do Nothing and Continue Laying Plans
choices.description: The more the enemy wants him to panic, the calmer he must be. Set aside Chen Nian's matter for now, focus on the chess game before him. His sister's matter... he would address it once he had sufficient strength.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Strategic Initiative, Don't Be Ruled by Emotions
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Nian Truly Is in Danger, It Will Be a Lifetime of Regret

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the letter into his chest, his expression returning to calm: 'Chen Nian... I've noted it.' Four words spoken lightly, yet as heavy as a thousand tons. Su Qingyao gazed at his back, suddenly feeling that this man bore far too much weight on his shoulders that no one his age should carry. She opened her mouth, wanting to say something, but ultimately could only release a sigh.

dialogue.content: 'You... truly can let it go?' Su Qingyao asked softly. Chen Ji turned around, his eyes utterly unruffled: 'Let it go? No. I simply know this: now is not the time.' He gazed at the night sky beyond the window, his eyes reflecting the scattered starlight. 'Once I've set up this chess game... even Heaven itself cannot stop me from rescuing her.'

text.content: Night deepened, and the lights of Tianqing Sect gradually flickered out. Chen Ji sat alone by the window, his fingers unconsciously caressing the cover of the Tianji Record. His mind replayed the day's events endlessly: the strange resonance of the ancient scroll fragment, Chen Nian's distress signal, the exposure of the alliance's insider, Mo Xiansheng's profound warning... All the clues pointed toward an increasingly clear truth—behind this chaotic world, an invisible black hand was manipulating everything. And what unsettled him even more was that the aura of that black hand bore a striking resemblance to some residual force within the Tianji Record...
